اقترعتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَعَتَا (iqtaraʕatā) /iq.ta.ra.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اُقْتُرِعَتَا (uqturiʕatā) /uq.tu.ri.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
